PASS: all linked ggml libraries resolve inside /mnt/raid0/llm/llama.cpp-experimental/build-v8-sanitize/bin
NOTE: ggml backends (ggml-hip, ggml-cpu-<arch>) are dlopened at RUNTIME and
      are not covered by ldd. Confirm the intended device appears in the
      program's own startup log (e.g. 'Device 0: AMD Instinct MI210') and
      do not trust a 'use gpu = 1' flag alone — that flag reports what was
      REQUESTED, not what was loaded.
